name: Miiden no Nichijou: Shinjin Buddy-hen
original_name: みーでんの日常　新人バディ編
source:
A super-short novel depicting the casual daily life of Sakura Yuki and Rito Almonte, two buddies in the magical soldier organization Mileden!

Listen to their stories, ask them questions, and enjoy their buddy interactions!

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11209]Novelgame[/url]]
